plan.title: Recipe amounts change after adding recipes to the shopping list
plan.wentWrong:
Open the app
Click "Add to shopping list"
Click "Crisp Waffles"
Click "Add to shopping list"
Click "Buttermilk Pancakes"
The Pancakes recipe now shows Plain flour 450 g, Eggs 4 and Butter 90 g, the shopping-list totals.
plan.shouldHappen:
A recipe's own amounts should not change when it is added to the shopping list.
"Plain flour" should show "200 g"
